text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is already coming to a close…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Perish the thought! I mean, there are so many exciting things to look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It appears that many have their eyes on me for the Shuka Sho. I wonder if it's just because of my family.
choice_data_list: It's because you're a great runner, of course.
It's because you're a great runner, of course.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting to hear those words. ♪ I truly hope that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It certainly wasn't just some sweet talk—she's improved considerably over the summer. And there's still room for further improvement.
choice_data_list: Let's stun everyone at the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, it will be a grand surprise! Let's knock their socks off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You wouldn't think summer camp was over by the racket you're making.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Take a look around—everyone's beat. You're the only one who treated camp like a vacation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You don't seem very beat. I guess that means you were on vacation too… But we both know that's not actually the case.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You and I both worked as hard as we could during camp, and the proof of that hard work is in the pudding. We've both gotten much better.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ability isn't decided by something as simple as the effort you put in.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so? I, for one, believe in the value of effort.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Magnificent practice brings splendid results.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ha. You truly are a noble little princess.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You never scream or blow your lid. …You're racing to the top as if there's no resistance at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I can see it. You're going to produce results that go beyond anything I first imagined.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Um… thank you? It's rare for you to offer such genuine praise.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt about it—you'll do well in both the Shuka Sho and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But that… That's where you peak, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …Don't you forget it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then you be sure not to miss it, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder what that was all about?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Well, maybe I should simply enjoy the praise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Based on Air Shakur's previous behavior, I can't imagine it was just simple praise… but Fine Motion appears to have taken it at face value.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, that's how our eventful summer camp comes to a close.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …That's your peak. In other words, it's only downhill from there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And you won't even struggle to go higher. What a cruel fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You'd have been better off if you never had any running talent to begin with.
